name: GAN i Carry 4 3x3 (Magnetic) - Minions Edition, Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i Carry 4 Minions Edition is an officially licensed GANCUBE and Illumination collaboration that drops a Minion right into the center of a connected 3x3 smart cube. Banana-yellow stickerless plastic, a big-eyed Minion center cap, and a denim-blue inner shell carry the theme from the core to the cover.
features: Exclusive in-app extras: The edition unlocks a Minions skin, in-app effects, and an avatar frame in the app.
Palm-sized and portable: The compact i Carry form factor fits easily in a hand, a bag, or a pocket.
Custom inner shell and magnetic system: A redesigned inner shell houses the magnets for stable, repeatable turning through a solve.
Frosted stickerless finish: Matte plastic with medium grip and colors molded into the pieces, so nothing peels or wears off with daily use.
Minion center cap: The signature big-eyed face is a molded center detail, not a sticker.
Compact i Carry build: Lightweight at 71 g and 56 mm, sized for quick, comfortable solving.
